carmen: quick one — I'm chasing missing child spans from the async-prefetcher job. Where's the fastest place to pull first-hop traces (worker -> kvcache) + related logs? I think the OTEL sampler might be dropping them.

alice: start with Trace Explorer filtered to service=prefetcher and a short time window. Use this quick link: https://obsv.redwood/trace-explorer?service=prefetcher :eyes: Also open the "Sampler Insights" dashboard (Observability -> Dashboards -> Sampler Insights) to see drop rates by service.

ben: if you can capture a single request id, run: `kubectl -n jobs logs deploy/prefetcher --since=10m | rg <request-id>` to trace logs. Grep for `trace_id`/`traceparent` headers in the logs.

carmen: gotcha. Any specific sampler sanity checks I should run?

alice: two quick experiments: 1) Temporarily set the SDK sampler to `parentbased_traceidratio(1.0)` for the prefetcher deployment to force-sample everything for 10-15m (repro window). 2) Check the OTEL SDK export queue for backlog (might drop spans on shut down).

ben: also confirm the Redis client is propagating the trace context. Common footgun: async worker hands off to threadpool and we lose context. Quick patch for node redis (example):
```js
// wrap before calling redis
const span = tracer.startSpan('redis.set');
propagator.inject(context.active(), headers);
await redis.set(key, value);
span.end();
```
If we don't inject, the remote side won't get `traceparent`.

oncall-bot: runbook pinned: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tracing-sampler-check (contains checklist: trace explorer link, sampler dashboard, exporter health, graceful shutdown settings)

carmen: nice. I'll bump to parent-based sampling and repro, then post a couple of trace ids here. Also going to tail the pod logs while triggering a job: `kubectl -n jobs exec -it deploy/prefetcher -- /bin/sh -c 'while true; do sleep 1; done'` then trigger.

ben: ping me when you have a trace id, I'll scavenge the logs + open a tiny PR to inject context into the redis helper. Should be a 5-line change.

carmen: thanks — doing the change now. If I can't reproduce with sampling at 100% we'll look at exporter backpressure and shutdown hooks.

alice: FYI if you need to force-last-mile visibility, you can temporarily enable `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` to our dev collector and tail the collector logs (helpful to see dropped spans on ingest).

carmen: perfect. will report back in ~30m with results. :thumbsup:
